description: Trigger a job when ServiceNow records match a target state.

instance_env_var.label: Instance Env Var
instance_env_var.description: Env var with ServiceNow instance name (e.g. mycompany). Required unless resource_key is set.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var with ServiceNow username. Required unless resource_key is set.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var with ServiceNow password. Required unless resource_key is set.

table.label: Table
table.description: ServiceNow table to query (e.g. change_request, incident)

sysparm_query.label: Sysparm Query
sysparm_query.description: ServiceNow encoded query string to filter records

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Job to trigger when matching records are found

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional resource key registered by a ServiceNowResourceComponent. When set, polls run via that resource's own list_records(...) method instead of the inline instance_env_var/username_env_var/password_env_var above -- shares one ServiceNow credential with servicenow_ingestion and servicenow_record_upsert.

name: ServiceNow Sensor
